# Independent challenge to a target-phase roster-handover assay

I am considering a new physical-only multi-agent handover host and want an
independent scientific challenge before any implementation or learned-policy
comparison. The question is whether carrying one public target plan through a
membership event can have direct bidirectional recovery and service value over
a fresh roster-size-canonical replan, while a stronger disruptive control
proves that the endpoints are sensitive. I especially want counterexamples and
simpler explanations; do not assume that a positive construction would imply a
latent is necessary.

The proposed host is a 96-sector ring with four stationary service docks
spaced 24 sectors apart. Episodes last 48 ticks and a membership event occurs
at tick 16. The two roster sizes are 12 and 20, with exactly three or five
agents required at each dock. Expansion activates two publicly staged
newcomers at each dock; contraction removes two staged-to-depart agents at each
dock. Before the event every active agent is at and publicly claims its dock.
Survivors retain position and previous claim. Newcomers have no persistent
identity but expose their staged target and position. Fresh public tie marks
order co-located agents and are discarded after use.

The common plan contains a target phase. The roster-size canonical phases are
zero for roster 12 and one for roster 20. Four cloned-state scripted packages
are proposed. CARRY retains the old phase and every survivor or staged-newcomer
target. CANONICAL-REPLAN resets to the destination roster's phase, so it is
identical to carry in static cells but rotates every target by one neighboring
dock in either churn direction. OPPOSITE-BREAK rotates every target by two
docks in churn cells and is the positive control. PUBLIC-MIN-SWITCH minimizes
target changes, then travel, then a public lexicographic vector, and should
equal carry. Uniform demand makes all four target assignments exact-demand;
there is no claim-count fragmentation.

After the event an agent keeps one target, moves at most three sectors per tick
along the shortest circular path, and on an exact half-ring tie moves
clockwise. Service is measured after movement; an agent serves a dock only if
it both claims that dock and is exactly co-located with it. Normalized unmet
demand is integrated over the 32 post-event ticks. Recovery is the first
post-event offset starting three consecutive zero-unserved ticks, censored at
32.

The proposed analytic certificate is exact. Carry and minimum-switch move zero
distance, giving recovery zero and service loss zero. Canonical replan moves
everyone 24 sectors in eight moves; the first seven measurements are fully
unserved and the eighth is served, giving recovery seven and integrated loss
7/32. The disruptive control moves everyone 48 sectors in sixteen moves; the
first fifteen measurements are fully unserved, giving recovery fifteen and
loss 15/32. Static contrasts are zero. The successor decision margins were
fixed in advance at more than three recovery ticks and more than 0.03 service
loss in both expansion and contraction. Absolute coherent-scaffold ceilings
are recovery at most one and loss at most 0.01 for carry/minimum-switch, and
recovery at most nine and loss at most 0.25 for canonical replan. The recovery
censor and the bounded service endpoint leave much more than the required
positive-control headroom from carry.

The intended maximum physical run, only if the proof survives, has four
packages, sixteen fresh roots, four cells, and 64 symmetry scenarios per
root/cell/package. Fresh roots may change only global rotation, reflection,
ephemeral within-dock order, and output ordering, never the certified
distances. There is no learned arm in this cycle. A matching run would support
only a finite existence claim and a decision about whether a later
KEEP/FLEX/FLEX-CLAMP learning experiment is worth asking.

Several objections are already live. The make-before-break arrival/departure
law is aligned with the old plan, so the host may bake in carry. A public
minimum-switch or simple previous-claim controller reproduces carry, so no plan
representation is necessary. The roster-size phase reset is a symmetry
canonicalization convention and may be an arbitrary weak comparator. Finally,
because the endpoint values follow algebraically from fixed distances, a run
may be only an implementation-conformance check rather than an answer-changing
physical observation.

Please determine whether the certificate and recovery indexing are actually
correct, construct the strongest policy or host counterexample that satisfies
the visible surface without supporting target-bound continuity, and decide
whether the physical run would add decision-relevant evidence. If this host is
too tautological or comparator-defined, propose the smallest genuinely new
public-state host or intervention that preserves analytic bidirectional
headroom but makes carry-versus-replan opportunity nontrivial. State what a
positive could support, what it could not support, and the condition under
which active investment should stop before learning. Keep the judgment bounded
to public-plan continuity through a physical roster event; do not import
covariance-aware timing or conclusions from another direction.
